package rulefixtures

import (
	"io"
)

// scenario for go_perf_layer_memory_allocation_temporary_byte_slice_for_string_write: Layer: Memory allocation. Flag []byte(string) conversions used only to write strings to writers.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
func scenario568Positive(w io.Writer, messages []string) (int, error) {
	var total int
	for _, msg := range messages {
		// []byte(msg) allocates a new byte slice on the heap per call.
		// io.WriteString(w, msg) or wrapping w in a bufio.Writer and
		// using WriteString avoids the allocation.
		n, err := w.Write([]byte(msg))
		total += n
		if err != nil {
			return total, err
		}
	}
	return total, nil
}
